en.name: Soy sauce or teriyaki sauce
en.summary: Soy sauce is brewed, heavily salted and remarkably stable: unopened it keeps about 3 years from purchase in the cupboard. After opening, the fridge gives about 1 month of its best flavour — and the label's advice to refrigerate is about quality, not safety.
en.pantry: An unopened bottle keeps about 3 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard, away from the hob and out of the sun. The point most people misunderstand is what happens after opening: shelf-stable commercial soy sauce and teriyaki sauce are safe when stored at room temperature after opening, and quality, not safety, is the reason the labels suggest refrigerating them. Refrigeration simply ensures commercial sauces and condiments stay fresh for a longer period of time. What an open bottle loses in a warm kitchen is aroma and colour — it darkens and flattens rather than becoming unsafe.
en.fridge: After opening, the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below holds the sauce at its best for about 1 month. That is a flavour window, not a safety deadline, and it surprises people used to keeping the same bottle on the table for a year. If you use soy sauce daily, a small table bottle refilled from a larger one kept cold is the practical compromise. Teriyaki sauce, which has sugar and often other ingredients added, fades faster than plain soy sauce and benefits more from the cold.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for soy sauce and no reason to freeze it. The salt concentration means it will not freeze solid at domestic freezer temperatures anyway, and the cupboard and the fridge already cover it comfortably. Buy the bottle size you will use, and decant into a small table bottle rather than storing a large one colder.
spoilage: Mould around the neck, the cap or the pouring spout
A musty or fermented-off smell rather than a rich, malty, savoury one
A thick sediment or film in a bottle that was clear
Flat, purely salty taste with none of the original aroma — old rather than unsafe
tips: Keep the main bottle cold and refill a small table bottle from it.
Wipe the pouring spout; dried sauce in the nozzle is where mould starts.
Keep bottles out of sunlight — light darkens and flattens soy sauce quickly.
Buy the size you will actually get through rather than the economical one.

faq.q: Does soy sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Not for safety — shelf-stable commercial soy sauce is safe at room temperature after opening. Refrigeration keeps its flavour fresher for longer.

faq.q: How long does soy sauce last after opening?
faq.a: About 1 month refrigerated at 4 °C or below for its best flavour. That is a quality window, not a safety limit.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle of soy sauce keep?
faq.a: About 3 years from purchase in a cool dark cupboard.
There is no timeline and no reason to. The salt keeps it from freezing solid, and the fridge already does the job.

zh.name: 醬油與照燒醬
zh.summary: 醬油是釀造、含鹽量高的產品，穩定得驚人：未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 3 年。開封後冷藏可以維持最佳風味大約 1 個月——而標籤建議冷藏，講的是品質而不是安全。
zh.pantry: 未開封的瓶子放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬，從購買日起算大約 3 年。多數人誤解的是開封之後：常溫販售的市售醬油和照燒醬，開封後放室溫仍然是安全的，標籤建議冷藏的理由是品質而不是安全。冷藏只是讓市售醬料維持新鮮更久。一瓶開封的醬油放在溫暖的廚房裡失去的是香氣和色澤——它會變深、變扁，而不是變得有危險。
zh.fridge: 開封後放 4 °C 以下冷藏，可以讓風味維持在最佳狀態大約 1 個月。那是風味窗口，不是安全期限，這常讓「同一瓶放桌上放一年」的人很意外。如果你每天都用醬油，實際的折衷做法是把大瓶冰著，再分裝到桌上的小瓶。照燒醬加了糖和其他成分，比純醬油更快走味，冷藏對它的幫助也更大。
zh.freezer: 醬油沒有冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。鹽濃度讓它在家用冷凍庫根本凍不硬，而櫥櫃加冰箱已經綽綽有餘。請買你用得完的容量，並分裝到桌上小瓶，而不是把一大瓶冰得更冷。
spoilage: 瓶口、瓶蓋或出水嘴周圍長霉
聞起來有霉味或發酵異味，而不是濃郁的麥香鹹鮮
原本清澈的瓶子出現濃厚沉澱或浮膜
只剩扁平的鹹味、完全沒有原本的香氣——那是老了，不是不安全
tips: 大瓶冰著，分裝到桌上的小瓶使用。
擦一下出水嘴；乾掉的醬油正是發霉的起點。
避免日曬——光會讓醬油很快變深、變扁。
買你真的用得完的容量，不要只看划算。

faq.q: 醬油開封後一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 以安全來說不用——常溫販售的市售醬油開封後放室溫仍然安全。冷藏是為了讓風味更久保持新鮮。

faq.q: 醬油開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 1 個月風味最好。那是品質窗口，不是安全期限。

faq.q: 未開封的醬油可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 3 年。
沒有對應期限，也沒有理由。鹽讓它凍不硬，而冷藏本來就夠用了。
